propositions: The live tickets branch .bridge_state/projects.json was overwritten with rehearsal fixture keys LEG/ONE/TWO/ZERO that do not exist in live Jira, causing jql_active to issue invalid JQL query 'project = LEG AND status != Done' which Jira rejects

The fetcher._build_snapshot multi-project fan-out reads all keys from projects.json and issues one JQL query per key; when a mapped key does not exist in Jira, the first query fails and reconcile_once raises, exiting the entire pass with status 1

The corruption was introduced via ad-hoc git commits (9f1b2cff98, 275bd7507e) by the test-fixture identity on the live tickets branch at 2026-08-14T19:18-0700, 21 minutes before the first consistent Reconcile Bridge failure at 2026-08-15T02:39Z

The canonical intended state of projects.json is {version:1, legacy_default:REB, projects:{}} with empty projects map; when projects is empty, the fan-out correctly falls back to the single configured project REB

The bridge-state write path lacks write_lock protection, commit/push hooks, and atomic semantics, enabling ad-hoc hand-mutations that bypass the unified store invariant, necessitating a follow-up refactor to adopt locked+committed writes
